features.localDesc: Runs entirely offline using local models — your data never leaves your machine. Your agent's brain is plain markdown you can read, edit, and version control. No cloud. No code. Full privacy.
features.brainDesc: Built like a human brain — memory, reasoning, and action work together in one agentic architecture. The agent remembers context, thinks step by step, and acts on your behalf.
features.extensibleDesc: Drop a folder with a SKILL.md to teach your agent something new instantly. Add tools, workflows, or entire capabilities — no config, no setup, just plug and go.
